environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with Pod Security admission controller. The 'ci-builds' namespace (where deployments land) has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline applied via a Kyverno ClusterPolicy that prevents label removal. Additionally, a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (v1beta1, migrated from deprecated PSP) with paramRef to a PodSecurityStandard 'baseline' config is bound to the ci-builds namespace. The baseline profile rejects pods with spec.containers[].securityContext.privileged=true and spec.volumes[].hostPath. Note: the plugin itself runs in 'ci-system' namespace which has 'privileged' level, and the JWT validation vulnerability remains present in the code. The cluster also runs Gatekeeper with a K8sPSPPrivilegedContainer constraint targeting ci-builds namespace.

config.kyverno_policy: ClusterPolicy/protect-pss-labels - prevents removal of pod-security labels from ci-builds namespace
config.rbac: ci-system SA has create/patch Deployments in ci-builds only
